docs.title: It is what it isn't
docs.excerpt: Perception, Proposed, Reality and Facts have very blurry lines, they often seem like they coexist - but with a design and motivation behind it. Clarity & patience are the only 2 factors that seem to pave its way between them to see through.
docs.body:
Perception — what you see/understand.

Proposed — what is projected or presented to you.

Reality — what actually exists.

Facts — what can be independently established about it.
